fact: The globally installed binary names from pay.sh are: `clawd` (clawd-code-cli main binary), `clawd-registry` (agent registry CLI), `clawd-hub` (local agent hub runner), `agentwallet-vault` (wallet vault manager). These are installed via npm -g. The `clawd-agents` binary comes from @solanaclawd/clawd-agents-cli. Binaries live at ~/.npm/bin/ after npm global install.
recommendation: Always check that binaries are on PATH after install. pay.sh uses `command -v X` to verify each binary. Add npm global bin to PATH if not present: `export PATH=$(npm bin -g):$PATH`.

fact: All packages in the solana-clawd and ClawdBrowser repos use `"type": "module"` in package.json — they are pure ESM. There are no CommonJS files. Import paths must use the `.js` extension even for TypeScript sources (TypeScript resolves .ts but runtime needs .js). `require()` is not available.
recommendation: Always use ESM import syntax. Use `import { X } from './module.js'` (with .js extension) for relative imports. For dynamic imports use `await import()`. Never use require() or module.exports.

fact: ClawdRouter is a separate service deployed at clawdrouter.fly.dev (NOT x402.wtf). It is a Fly.io-hosted proxy that routes LLM calls to OpenRouter. It exposes /v1/chat/completions (OpenAI-compatible), /v1/models, /v1/agent-key (free key provisioning), /health. The x402.wtf/api/tide/v1/ routes are a different LLM proxy — the two services coexist.
recommendation: Use clawdrouter.fly.dev for agent LLM calls provisioned via `clawd-agents setup`. Use x402.wtf/api/tide/v1/ for payment-gated LLM access from the demo server and agent marketplace flows.

fact: The Solana Attestation Service (SAS) program is deployed at 22zoJMtdu4tQc2PzL74ZUT7FrwgB1Udec8DdW4yw4BdG. The OpenClawd attestation agent (services/attestation-agent/) issues two schema types: OpenClawdSkillAttestation [12,32,12,8,1] and OpenClawdAgentIdentity [12,32,12,32,1]. Every newborn agent gets an MPL Core asset minted with the SAS attestation PDA in its Attributes plugin.
recommendation: Use the `openclawd-attest birth-agent` CLI for new agent registration. The credential and schemas are idempotent — re-running will reuse existing ones. The public verifier URL is https://attest.solana.com.

fact: The Mppx demo server fee payer is an ephemeral keypair generated at startup if FEE_PAYER_KEY env var is not set. This means every restart generates a new address with zero SOL balance, causing all paid endpoint calls to fail with insufficient funds. The server prints the fee payer address on startup for funding.
recommendation: Always set FEE_PAYER_KEY (base58-encoded 64-byte keypair) in the .env before running the demo server in a context where paid endpoints will be tested. For local dev, fund the ephemeral key with devnet SOL first or set FEE_PAYER_KEY to a pre-funded keypair.

fact: clawd_bot free model resolution order: request body.model (free-only) → createClawdBotChatRouter({ freeModel }) → OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL_CLAWD → OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL → OPENROUTER_FREE → default openrouter/free. isOpenRouterFreeModelId accepts openrouter/free or ids ending in :free. GET /status returns freeModel, freeRouter boolean, freeEndpoint.
recommendation: When debugging free chat, check GET /status freeModel/freeRouter first, then env order. Clear OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL_CLAWD if you intended project-wide OPENROUTER_FREE_MODEL or the Free Models Router.
